name: bochtCMS
line: an MCP-only CMS, and the curve its tests missed
question: What does a passing test suite miss when a CMS freezes on a long post?
body: Bend series, part 2. A blog CMS on bocht whose only interface is seven MCP tools. Its 43 tests passed on every version, including the one that froze for two minutes on a long post. One function fixed: 1,200× faster, same bytes out.
alt: bochtCMS: time to save one post bending upward with size before the fix, flat after it
